title: My Favourite Month
text:
My favourite month is July. It is summer in July. The days are long and warm. I go to the beach with my family.

In August, my school friend has a birthday. His birthday is on the tenth of August. We have a small party in the garden. He gets a new bike.

questions.text: What is the writer's favourite month?
How does the writer probably feel about summer?
Why does the writer probably go to the beach in July?
options: Because it is warm and sunny
Because the writer is at school

vocabulary.definition: the seventh month of the year
the warm season between spring and autumn
an area of sand or stones next to the sea
the day of the year when a person was born

paragraph_translations: Mój ulubiony miesiąc to lipiec. W lipcu jest lato. Dni są długie i ciepłe. Chodzę na plażę z rodziną.
W sierpniu mój kolega ze szkoły ma urodziny. Jego urodziny są dziesiątego sierpnia. Robimy małe przyjęcie w ogrodzie. On dostaje nowy rower.
